subject: audience-absorption-at-scale
seam: crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/picker.rs score(): +1.2 first_contact boost to every first contact, raid or not; the orchestrator detected a raid (RAID_FIRST_CONTACTS=5, orchestrate/mod.rs) but only used it to expire the queued bit, so every raid arrival kept its individual boost (technique step 5 unimplemented)
seam_choice: chosen to falsify: the raid ritual already collapses into waves and the deterministic path decides every raid beat (<=23 candidates, under llm_threshold 40), so suppressing singleton boosts could have returned nothing to the room. It nearly did: suppressing singletons alone (arm B) gave the room 26 -> 31 because the freed slot went to a second raid wave; keeping the boost on the largest wave only (arm C, shipped) gave 34
proof: ab-paired offline replay, sim raid_moment room (300 CCV, 900 s, 8 seeds), InputFilter + Orchestrator.observe_inbox + Picker through both policies; 46 raid beats, 92 slots. Room picks 26 -> 34, raider singleton picks 16 -> 4, beats greeting the raid twice 24 -> 19. Raid-time near-duplicate clustering for first messages (arm AD) moved room picks only 26 -> 29 and was not shipped
floor: raid episodes with no greeting 2/20 -> 2/20; non-raid beats byte-identical (28 rows); cargo test --workspace green, fmt check, clippy -D warnings on shadowrunr-brain
also: harness ignores carry and plan offers; steps 1-4 already conform (first message exempt from rate cap after term rules, exact-only clustering, lapse via seen set)

subject: audience-absorption-at-scale
seam: crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs PickContext.raid = orch.is_raid(): the raid flag that strips raiders' first_contact boost is per beat (5 first contacts in one 5 s beat), while track_raid already recognises a raid spread over RAID_WINDOW_MS for the greeting; step 4 asks raiders to stay a group for about a minute
seam_choice: chosen to falsify: a caught outcome would show the per-beat flag is not what lets raiders take the minute, so a window cannot move the share
arms: A as is; B raid flag held RAID_GROUP_MS=60 s after any raid detection (one beat, spread, or in a scene), patch kept out of the tree
instrument: crates/shadowrunr-sim runner::tests::raid_window_replay (ignored): real brain + ScriptedEngine, raid_moment 300 and 40, growing_channel 30, 8 seeds, 900 s; raid clock = first raider line
target: room share of picks in the minute after the raid: 300-room A 28/90 B 29/89; 40-room A 6/52 B 6/52
floor: picks before the raid and in a raid-free room must be identical: B changed pre-raid picks in 7/16 raid runs and the whole run in 2/8 growing_channel runs (the 5-in-20 s tracker trips on ordinary arrivals) -> broken
finding: 108 raider picks in raid first minutes (arm A): 98 carry novel (+0.8, never-picked viewer), 63 first_contact, 47 carried, 57 stale, 28 greet; the novelty bonus is a second newcomer boost the step leaves standing, and raiders win the small room by volume
shipped: instrument only (test code); product change not shipped
return: re-run with novel suppressed for raid arrivals and the window keyed to a named raid (raid_named) or a platform raid event rather than the surge tracker; a CAUGHT floor needs zero pre-raid and growing_channel changes
